generic.marketBarText: Balanced screening assessing core competency alignment, clear communication, and demonstrated project execution.
expectationChecklist: Verifiable core skill evidence in either professional experience or personal projects
Standard clear formatting without dense unreadable styling
Relevant degree or demonstrable equivalent experience

top_product.marketBarText: Ruthless evaluation focusing on algorithmic depth, distributed systems, scale metrics (latency, QPS, volume), and high-agency engineering.
expectationChecklist: Concrete scale metrics (e.g., QPS, latency p99, data volume)
High subsystem ownership and deep architectural trade-off awareness

startup.marketBarText: Bias towards rapid zero-to-one delivery, full-stack product versatility, pragmatism, and high autonomy.
expectationChecklist: Demonstrated 0-to-1 feature delivery or greenfield project execution
Product velocity and full-stack problem solving

service_mnc.marketBarText: Focus on exact keyword compliance, certifications, client delivery methodology, and reliable execution within structured processes.
expectationChecklist: Exact keyword alignment with client requirements
